descriptions.A_phys_ppm: Published physics asymmetry after the experiment's corrections; not the raw helicity asymmetry.
descriptions.stat_ppm: Published one-standard-deviation statistical error on A_phys.
descriptions.syst_ppm: Published systematic error on A_phys; correlation matrix is unavailable here.
descriptions.total_reported_ppm: Published total experimental error; its rounded quadrature is checked against stat and syst.
descriptions.CJ_published_ppm: CJ-based prediction copied from the paper for comparison; not recomputed by this study.
descriptions.x: Bjorken x = Q2/[W2-M2+Q2], using the declared nucleon mass.
descriptions.y: Fractional electron energy loss: nu/E, with nu=(W2-M2+Q2)/(2M).
descriptions.F1p: Computed free-proton transverse electromagnetic structure function.
descriptions.F1n: Computed free-neutron transverse electromagnetic structure function.
descriptions.F1_free_sum: F1p+F1n; electromagnetic reference for the free p+n construction.
descriptions.F1d_smeared: Per-deuteron F1 from the CD-Bonn on-shell electromagnetic smearing model; QE excluded.
descriptions.F2d_smeared: Per-deuteron electromagnetic F2 after the specified smearing; QE excluded.
descriptions.R_free: Electromagnetic longitudinal/transverse ratio from the free p+n F1 and F2.
descriptions.R_smeared: Electromagnetic longitudinal/transverse ratio from the smeared deuteron F1 and F2.
descriptions.Y3_free: Finite-Q2 axial kinematic factor using R_free.
descriptions.Y3_closure: Finite-Q2 axial kinematic factor using R_smeared in the common-response ansatz.
descriptions.A_free_ppm: Calculated free-p+n asymmetry under charge symmetry, light valence, and RgammaZ=Rgamma.
descriptions.A_closure_ppm: Calculated asymmetry imposing a common transverse weak/electromagnetic smeared response.
descriptions.A_closure_SW2_0232_ppm: Closure asymmetry with sin2(thetaW)=0.232; an input convention variation, not a fitted value.
descriptions.A_Rgz_08R_ppm: Closure asymmetry with RgammaZ=0.8*Rgamma; illustrative scenario, not an error endpoint.
descriptions.A_Rgz_12R_ppm: Closure asymmetry with RgammaZ=1.2*Rgamma; illustrative scenario, not an error endpoint.
descriptions.coeff_C1_closure_ppm: Signed coefficient multiplying dimensionless 2C1u-C1d in the closure asymmetry.
descriptions.coeff_C2_closure_ppm: Signed coefficient multiplying dimensionless 2C2u-C2d in the closure asymmetry.
descriptions.residual_closure_ppm: Closure-model asymmetry minus the published physics asymmetry.
